description: This file declares the polar_code_impl class, which implements a polar code interface using look-up tables, including static data members for code and interleaver tables, and methods for configuration and data retrieval.

classes.name: polar_code_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the polar code interface based on look-up tables, providing methods for setting code parameters and accessing code properties.

methods.name: get_n
methods.description: Returns the base-2 logarithm of the number of coded bits.

methods.name: get_N
methods.description: Returns the number of coded bits.

methods.name: get_K
methods.description: Returns the number of message bits.

methods.name: get_E
methods.description: Returns the number of rate-matched encoded bits.

methods.name: get_nPC
methods.description: Returns the number of parity-check bits.

methods.name: get_K_set
methods.description: Returns the set of indices for message bits.

methods.name: get_PC_set
methods.description: Returns the set of indices for parity-check bits.

methods.name: get_F_set
methods.description: Returns the set of indices for frozen bits.

methods.name: get_ibil
methods.description: Returns the status of the internal bit interleaver.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Configures the code parameters with message size K, codeword size E, maximum code length nMax, and interleaver settings.
